DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人の切符をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you buying tickets for two people?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この往復を選べば、私と友人が一枚ずつ使えますか。二人で同じ所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復を二人分と考えて購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I choose this round trip, can my friend and I each use one ticket? We're both going to the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can buy a round trip thinking it provides travel for two people.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 往復は行きと帰りの利用です。お二人とも片道をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: A round trip covers the outward and return journeys. Do both of you want one-way travel?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。帰りは別の人の車に乗ります。電車は二人の行きだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人とも片道で帰りは車だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. We'll return in someone else's car. We only need the train for the two of us going there.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that both of you need one-way travel and will return by car.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数と行き帰りは分けて選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please select the number of people separately from outward and return travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 片道を二人分にします。友人も大人です。画面の人数を二人にしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大人二人の片道にして人数操作を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose one-way tickets for two. My friend is also an adult. Should I set the number of people on the screen to two?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one-way travel for two adults and confirm the passenger-count operation in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。行き先と人数を確認してから購入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Check the destination and number of people before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ行き先で大人二人ですね。友人の分も私が払いますが、切符は別々に持つんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まとめ払いでも切符を一人ずつ使うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The same destination for two adults, then. I'll pay for my friend's too, but we each keep a separate ticket, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that even with one payment, each person uses their own ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お一人ずつ、ご自身の切符を使って改札を通ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Each person should use their own ticket to pass through the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を受け取ったら一枚を友人へ渡します。往復の二枚と人数の二枚を混ぜないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を分け同行者へ渡し購入条件を照合すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I receive two tickets, I'll give one to my friend. I'll check so I don't confuse two round-trip tickets with tickets for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate the two tickets, give one to your companion and check the purchase conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。購入前に、片道、大人二人、行き先の表示をもう一度ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Before purchasing, check the one-way, two-adult and destination displays once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望のご利用についてご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about using the observation area?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私は高い所が苦手です。子どもだけ上へ行かせるのではなく、妻と二人で利用する方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高所が苦手で妻子だけの利用方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm uncomfortable with heights. Rather than send my child up alone, I'd like to ask how my wife and child can use it together.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how your wife and child can visit without you because you are uncomfortable with heights.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族の利用人数を分けて伺います。お客様は地上でお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ask separately how many family members will use it. Will you wait at ground level?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうしたいです。三人で来ましたが、上へ行くのは妻と子どもの二人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来訪三人と展望利用二人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to. Three of us came, but only my wife and child, two people, will go up.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the three visitors from the two observation-area users.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待つ場所と、展望の受付について確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the waiting place and observation-area registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私も同行の人数に入れて、三人分を買う必要があるとは決めず、利用する二人の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行人数だけで三人分を買わず利用条件を確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume I must buy for three just because I'm part of the group. I'll check the conditions for the two people using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check usage conditions rather than buy for three solely because three people came together.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が人数と条件をご案内します。お戻りの待合せ場所は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will explain the numbers and conditions. Have you decided where to meet when they return?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。外の入口だと雨に濡れるので、屋内で待てる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雨を避けた地上の屋内待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. We'd get wet at the outside entrance, so please tell me somewhere indoors where I can wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for an indoor ground-level waiting place out of the rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの待機場所を確認します。通路をふさがない所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check this waiting area and show you somewhere that doesn't block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所が分かったら妻に伝えます。別々に動く前に、私が地上で待つことと合流場所を三人で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 離れる前に待機と合流場所を家族で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I know the place, I'll tell my wife. Before we separate, all three of us will confirm that I'll wait at ground level and where we'll meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the family will confirm waiting arrangements and the meeting place before separating.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二人の利用と、一人の待機として担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll tell staff that two people will visit and one will wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the queue?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがトイレへ行きたいと言っています。私と子どもが出て、夫だけここに残ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どものトイレで親子が列を離れる可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child says they need the toilet. May my child and I leave while only my husband stays here?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you and your child may leave the queue for the child's toilet visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列を離れる場合の扱いを確認します。まだお二人は列の中ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check how leaving the queue is handled. Both of you are still in the queue, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。勝手に抜けて戻れると思わず、出る前に聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ列内で出る前に確認していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than assume we can leave and return on our own, I came to ask before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are still in the queue and checking before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご家族の位置を確認し、担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check your family's position and guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもを一人で行かせず、私が付き添います。待つ夫にどう伝えるかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子を一人で行かせず付き添い待つ家族への伝え方も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I'll accompany my child rather than send them alone. I'd also like advice on what to tell my husband who will wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will accompany your child rather than send them alone, and ask how to inform the waiting family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 再合流の方法も確認します。お父様はどの辺りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check how to rejoin too. Where is the child's father?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この曲がり角の手前です。家族だけで場所を決めて他の方の前へ入り直さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機家族の位置を示し自己判断で割り込まないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just before this corner. We won't decide the spot ourselves as a family and re-enter in front of others.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your waiting family member's position and say in Japanese that you will not cut in on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ位置とご希望を伝えます。戻り方は案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell staff the location and your request. Please receive instructions on returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず付き添ってトイレへ行く方法を確認し、戻った時も係員の指示に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 離れる方法と戻る方法を係員の案内で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll first check how to accompany my child to the toilet, and follow staff instructions when we return too.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check both leaving and returning procedures with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。列にいるご家族へお声がけして、離れる際の手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll speak to your family member in the queue and explain the procedure for leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの案内についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about this notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。中止とあるので、今日は全部見られないと家族へ言って帰ろうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中止表示を一日全体と解釈し帰ろうとしたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Seeing “cancelled,” I thought of telling my family we couldn't see anything today and going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you interpreted the cancellation sign as covering the entire day and were about to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示は二時の回についてです。ほかの予定とは分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice concerns the two o'clock session. Please check it separately from other scheduled activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時の一回なんですね。次の回も必ず中止だと書いてあるわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示が二時の一回で次の回の決定と別だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's just the two o'clock session. It doesn't say the next one is definitely cancelled too, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the notice concerns one two-o'clock session and is separate from a decision on the next.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今後の案内は更新されます。次の実施をここで確約することもできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Future information will be updated. We also cannot guarantee here that the next session will run.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族には二時の回が中止と伝えます。次は未確定なので、今見られる屋内の案内も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ確定情報だけ伝え現在利用できる屋内案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my family the two o'clock session is cancelled. The next is unconfirmed, so I'd also like information about indoor things we can see now.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell family only confirmed facts and request information about currently available indoor activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図で、現在利用できる所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the map for places currently available.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外で次の回をずっと待つより、家族と相談して屋内へ移ります。戻るなら最新の表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 屋内へ予定を変え戻る場合は更新を確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than keep waiting outside for the next session, I'll discuss it with family and move indoors. If we return, we'll check the latest display.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will change the plan to indoors and check updates if returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。天候に関する放送にもご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also pay attention to weather announcements.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部中止とも次は必ずあるとも言わず、分かっている一回の情報で予定を組み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全面中止や次回実施を断言せず予定を組み直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't say everything is cancelled or the next session will definitely happen. I'll rearrange our plans using the information known about this one session.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will reorganize plans without asserting total cancellation or a guaranteed next session.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご家族と合流して、更新された案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Meet up with your family and check the updated information.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で確認したい言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any words on the medical questionnaire you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲酒の欄です。毎日薬を飲むので、毎日に丸を付けようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲酒欄を毎日の服薬だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The drinking section. I take medicine every day, so I was going to circle “daily.”
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the alcohol section meant daily medicine use.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここはお酒を飲むことについての欄です。薬の服用は別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This section concerns drinking alcohol. We'll ask about taking medicine separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お酒なら普段は飲みません。薬を飲む回数ではなかったんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 酒は飲まず薬の回数と取り違えたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: If it means alcohol, I don't normally drink. It wasn't asking how often I take medicine, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct in Japanese that you do not drink alcohol and confused the section with medication frequency.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。薬については、こちらの欄と持参資料を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. For medicine, please show this field and the materials you brought to medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お薬手帳があります。酒は飲まない、薬は毎日飲むと、それぞれ書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手帳を示し飲酒と服薬を分けて書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my medicine record book. May I write separately that I don't drink alcohol and take medicine every day?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the record book and ask in Japanese whether to enter alcohol and medication use separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分けてご記入ください。分からない薬の名前は資料で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write them separately. Medication names you don't know can be checked in your documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この薬の名前をうまく読めないので、自分で別の名前に直さず、手帳を添えて確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読めない薬名を自己流で直さず資料確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can't read this medicine's name well, so rather than change it to another name myself, I'd like it checked with the record book attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the documents to be checked rather than rewriting an unreadable medicine name yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へお伝えします。記入した飲酒の欄もお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell staff. Please also show the alcohol section you completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲まないに丸を付けました。薬の欄には毎日と書き、名前は手帳で確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲酒欄の記入と服薬頻度を示し薬名の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I circled “do not drink.” In the medication field I wrote “daily”; please check the name in the record book.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the completed alcohol field and medication frequency and request a medicine-name check in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。飲酒と服薬を区別した内容として、医療担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass this to medical staff as information distinguishing alcohol from medication.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの通知を受け取ったのはお客様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're the person who received this notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私宛てです。友人が日本語を手伝いに来ました。友人の名前も呼ばれる人として書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分宛て通知に通訳友人も呼出対象として書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, it's addressed to me. A friend came to help with Japanese. Should I also write my friend's name as someone to be called?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether your interpreting friend should also be listed for calling on a notice addressed to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談されるご本人と、同席を希望する方は分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ask separately who is receiving the consultation and who wishes to attend with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談するのは私です。友人に同じ通知が来たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談本人は自分で友人には通知が来ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm the one receiving the consultation. My friend didn't receive the same notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are the person seeking advice and your friend did not receive a notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同席できるかと、説明のお手伝いの範囲は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check with staff whether your friend may attend and the scope of help with explanations.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が来たから、私が話さなくても全部代わりに答えられるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の同行だけで代理回答が認められるとは決めないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume that because my friend came, they may answer everything for me without me speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a friend's accompaniment alone does not mean proxy answers are permitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人のお話も確認します。分からない時は聞き直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check your own account too. If you don't understand, please ask again.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。友人にも、私の返事を勝手に作らず、言葉を確認してから訳してほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人にも返事を作らず本人確認後に訳すよう頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'll also tell my friend not to invent my answers, but to check my words before translating them.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask your friend not to create answers and to translate after confirming with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を記録します。通知とご本人の資料をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record that request. Please keep the notice and your own documents with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。私は通知の本人、友人は同席希望として、扱いを確認してから席へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人資料を示し友人は同席希望として確認後に進むと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here they are. I'm the notice recipient and my friend wishes to accompany me; we'll check how that is handled before going to the seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your own documents and say in Japanese that you will proceed only after checking your friend's requested attendance.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人の相談と友人の同席希望を担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll tell staff about your consultation and your friend's wish to attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 机について何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この傷が気になります。注文すると、この展示品が家へ届くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示机の傷を示しその現物が届くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This scratch concerns me. If I order, is this display item what will be delivered to my home?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the display desk's scratch and ask in Japanese whether that actual item will be delivered.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示品と、別の在庫からお届けする商品は分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll explain the display item separately from products delivered from other stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展示で形を見るだけなら、傷のあるこの机を買うこととは違うんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示を見ることと展示現物の購入を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So just viewing the shape on display is different from buying this scratched desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese viewing the display from purchasing that actual display item.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ただ、今回お選びになる品の在庫と状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. However, let's check the stock and condition of the item you choose this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展示品の値引きの札もありますが、私は傷のない別の品を希望します。同じ金額とは思わず見積りをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傷のない別在庫を希望し展示割引と同額にせず見積りを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's also a display-item discount sign, but I'd like a different, unscratched item. Please give me a quote rather than assume it's the same price.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request different unscratched stock and a quote in Japanese, without assuming the display discount price applies.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の種類を確認します。色はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll confirm the type you want. Is this the color you'd like?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この茶色がよいです。型番と色を書いてもらえますか。展示品の値札の写真だけで注文しないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 型番と色の記載を頼み写真の札だけで注文しないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I like this brown. Could you write down the model number and color? I don't want to order just from a photograph of the display price tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the model and color in writing and say you won't order based only on the photographed display tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品と価格を確認して、見積りへ記載します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll confirm the product and price and put them on the quotation.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見積りで型番、色、展示品ではないことを確かめてから、購入するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見積りの品目条件を確認してから購入を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the quotation's model, color and that it isn't the display item before deciding whether to buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide on purchase after checking the item conditions in the quote.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。在庫の確認が取れてから、条件をまとめてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. After confirming stock, we'll explain the conditions together.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの果物をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at this fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一個欲しいです。この値札を見て、箱から一個取ってよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一個を見本箱から取ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like one. Seeing this price tag, I thought I could take one from the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may take one fruit from the sample box.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その値札は一箱の表示です。まだ商品は動かしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That price tag is for one box. You haven't moved the products yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。触る前に聞きました。見本の箱から自由に一個選ぶ物だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ触っておらず箱売りの表示を誤解したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I asked before touching them. I thought you could freely choose one from the sample box.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not touched it and misunderstood the box-sale sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少量で買える物があるか確認します。何にお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether we sell smaller quantities. What will you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の昼に一人で食べます。一箱は使い切れないので、箱の値段を一個分に割って買えるとは決めずに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人の昼食用で箱を使い切れず単価計算でばら購入を決めないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll eat it alone at lunch today. I can't finish a box, so I'd like to ask rather than assume I can divide the box price and buy one.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is lunch for one and you cannot finish a box, without assuming a calculated unit price permits individual purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの別売場なら、少量のパックをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this other section, we can show you small packs.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そちらを見ます。この見本箱はそのままにして、買える単位が分かる売場で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本を動かさず少量販売の売場へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look there. I'll leave this sample box as it is and choose in a section where the sales units are clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the sample untouched and go to the small-quantity section.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。包装の単位と表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the packaging units and labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一箱しか扱わない物を無理に分けてもらわず、食べ切れるパックを探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱販売の物を無理に分けず食べ切れる包装を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Rather than insist you split something sold only by the box, I'll look for a pack I can finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose manageable packaging without insisting on splitting a box-sale product.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。奥の少量販売の表示へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Head toward the small-quantity sales sign at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の確認でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。夫婦で一緒に相談するのに、私と夫が別々に申し込んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一の夫婦相談を二人が別々に申し込んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My husband and I both applied separately even though we want one consultation together as a couple.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that both spouses separately applied for the same joint consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの申込内容は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the details of both applications?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は火曜十時、夫は火曜十一時です。同じ相談を二回受けたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの日時を示し二回相談する意図はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine is Tuesday at ten, and my husband's is Tuesday at eleven. We don't want the same consultation twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the two appointment times and say in Japanese that you do not intend two consultations.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付状況と、どちらを利用するか担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the registration status and which one to use with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時を希望します。ただ、十一時が取消し済みとは自分で決めず、二つの控えを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望時刻を示しもう一件を取消済みと決めず両控えの確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: We prefer ten. But please check both confirmation records rather than let me assume eleven is already cancelled.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the preferred time and ask in Japanese for both records to be checked without assuming the other appointment is cancelled.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで両方を確認します。お二人とも十時なら参加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check both here. Can both of you attend at ten?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。二人で一つの相談を希望します。夫の申込みを私だけで変更できるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人の参加可否と他方申込を変更できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We want one consultation for the two of us. I'd also like to check whether I can change my husband's application alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm both can attend and ask in Japanese whether you may change the other person's application.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込者の確認が必要な場合は、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the applicant needs verification, the staff will explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夫にも控えを用意してもらいます。一つが確定し、もう一つの扱いが分かってから予定表を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夫の控えも用意し両申込の結果確認後に予定を直すと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask my husband to prepare his confirmation too. I'll revise our calendar after one appointment is confirmed and we know how the other is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prepare your husband's record too and update plans after checking the outcome of both applications.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。重なった申込みとして、十時の希望と変更の確認を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll tell staff about the duplicate applications, your ten-o'clock preference and the change checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今年の通知だと思って持ってきましたが、ここには去年の年が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参通知に前年の年があると気付いて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought it thinking it was this year's, but the year written here is last year.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you noticed the notice you brought has the previous year's date.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ封筒に、ほかの年度の紙も入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were papers from other fiscal years in the same envelope too?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二年分を一緒に入れていました。封筒の新しさだけで、全部今年の物だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二年分を同じ封筒に入れ新しい封筒で全て今年と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I kept two years together. I thought everything was from this year just because the envelope was new.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you kept two years in one envelope and thought all were current because the envelope was new.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象の年度と通知名を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the relevant fiscal year and notice name separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はこの古い紙だけなので、今年の金額の説明を受けたことにはしないで、必要な資料を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今年の金額を確認済みにせず必要資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I have only this old paper, so please tell me what documents are needed without treating this as an explanation of this year's amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for required documents without treating this year's amount as confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談したいのは今年届いた通知ですね。その紙全体を確認できるようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: You want to discuss the notice that arrived this year, correct? Please bring it so we can inspect the whole paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家で年と通知名を見て分けます。金額の部分だけ切り取らず、全体を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 年度と通知名で分け紙を切らず全体持参すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. At home I'll separate them by year and notice name. I won't cut out only the amount; I'll bring the whole paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will sort by year and notice name and bring whole uncut documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 前年分も経緯の確認に必要なら、別にしてお持ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the previous year's documents are needed for context, you may bring them separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今年分と前年分を二つの袋に分けます。どの紙について聞くのか分かる状態で、改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年度ごとに保管し相談対象が分かる状態で再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put this year's and last year's in two separate bags. I'll return for advice with it clear which paper I'm asking about.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will store them by year and consult again with the target document clearly identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日は今年の内容を確認できていない相談として、持参資料をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Today this year's contents remain unconfirmed; we'll explain what documents to bring on that basis.
